 Order
Date : 12.08.2024 Heard Mr. T. Kalita, learned counsel for the appellant.

2. This appeal, under Section 173 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988, is directed against the judgment and order dated 30.04.2024, passed by the learned Member, Motor Accident Claims Tribunal,
Nagaon, in MAC Case No. 127/2022.
3.

It is to be noted here that vide impugned judgment and order dated 30.04.2024, the learned Member, Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Nagaon has directed the appellant, National Insurance Co. Ltd. to pay a sum of Rs. 1,01,07,696/-, being the compensation amount to the respondents in this appeal.

4. Perused the memo of appeal and the grounds mentioned therein and also perused the impugned judgment and order dated 30.04.2024.
5.
However, the appellant shall deposit 50% of the awarded amount before the Registry of this Court within a period of three weeks from today.
Liberty is also given to the respondents to withdraw the same from the Registry on filing an application to that effect.
6. Issue notice returnable in four weeks.
Steps be taken upon the respondents by way of registered post with A/D as well as by usual process within a week from today.
8. Registry shall call for the record from the Court of learned Member, Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Nagaon.

9. List the matter after four weeks.
